title: Words to Tokens Estimator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Estimate the token count of six documents from their word counts and decide whether each fits a context window with a 2,000-token reply.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the estimated token count of a document from its word count and decide whether the document and a 2,000-token reply fit in a given context window, correct on at least 5 of 6 items.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Items 5 and 6 use the same document. Explain what changed, and what did not.
commonMisconceptions: A token is a word, so the token count equals the word count.
The context window holds only the document, and the reply does not count against it.
A document that fits by itself also fits with the reply.
A model with a larger window can always use all of it.
